reasoning_content: Let me explore the environment and check what tools are available.

action.command: echo "=== tools ==="; for t in cargo rustc rustup node npm pnpm corepack just wasm-pack bacon sqlx docker nix; do printf "%-12s " "$t"; command -v $t 2>/dev/null || echo "MISSING"; done; echo; echo "=== versions ==="; cargo --version 2>/dev/null; node --version 2>/dev/null; pnpm --version 2>/dev/null; docker --version 2>/dev/null; docker compose version 2>/dev/null; just --version 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== os ==="; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; uname -a; nproc; free -h; df -h /workspace
